    | {{#if: {{{last|}}}

      | {{{author}}}
    }}
  }}
}}{{#if: {{{author|}}}{{{last|}}}

}}{{#if: {{{author|}}}{{{last|}}}|

      | {{#if: {{{month|}}}
        | &#32;({{{month}}} {{{year}}})

      }}
    }}
  |}}
}}{{#if: {{{last|}}}{{{author|}}}

  #if: {{{editor|}}}

}}{{#if: {{{archiveurl|}}}

    | {{#if: {{{url|}}} | {{#if: {{{title|}}} | [{{{url}}} {{{title}}}] }}}}
}}{{#if: {{{language|}}} | &#32;<span style="font-size: 0.95em; font-weight: bold; color:#555; position: relative;">({{{language}}})</span> 
}}{{#if: {{{format|}}}

}}{{#if: {{{work|}}}

}}{{#if: {{{pages|}}}

}}{{#if: {{{publisher|}}}

    | 
    | {{#if: {{{date|}}}{{{year|}}}{{{month|}}} || }}
  }}
}}{{#if: {{{author|}}}{{{last|}}}
  ||{{#if: {{{date|}}}

    | {{#if: {{{year|}}}
      | {{#if: {{{month|}}}
        | &#32;({{{month}}} {{{year}}})
        | &#32;({{{year}}})
      }}
    }}
  }}
}}.{{#if: {{{archivedate|}}}
  | &#32;已于{{#time:F j, Y|{{{archivedate}}}}}{{#if: {{{archiveyear|}}} | , {{{archiveyear}}} }}从[{{{url}}} 原文]归档。
}}{{#if: {{{accessdate|}}}
